name: Rikka Takarada
source: Rikka Takarada is Yuta Hibiki's girlfriend and one of the lead supporting characters in SSSS.GRIDMAN. Despite being apprehensive about Gridman Alliance at first, she develops a strong determination to help Yuta fight Kaiju in order to protect her loved ones.
translation: Rikka Takarada is Yuta Hibiki's girlfriend and one of the lead supporting characters in SSSS.GRIDMAN. Despite being apprehensive about Gridman Alliance at first, she develops a strong determination to help Yuta fight Kaiju in order to protect her loved ones.
